name: OUTsurance Group Limited
summary: OUTsurance Group Limited, an investment holding company based in Johannesburg, South Africa, since its establishment in 1977, provides an extensive portfolio of financial products and services to a global clientele. Its international presence spans South Africa, the broader African continent, the United Kingdom, various Asian markets (including China, Singapore, and Japan), Australia, Europe, and the United States. The company, which was rebranded from Rand Merchant Investment Holdings Limited in December 2022, manages its operations through four core divisions: Discovery, Momentum Metropolitan, OUTsurance, and Hastings. The Discovery segment is dedicated to integrated financial solutions, covering healthcare funding, insurance, and banking. These services are delivered under prominent brands such as Discovery Health, Life, Insure, Invest, Vitality, VitalityHealth, VitalityLife, Ping An Health, and Discovery Bank. Momentum Metropolitan offers a comprehensive array of financial provisions, including life insurance, employee benefits, investment and savings vehicles, healthcare plans, and short-term insurance. It caters to a diverse client base, from individuals and small to medium-sized businesses to large corporations and public sector entities, utilizing its Momentum and Metropolitan brands. The OUTsurance division focuses on direct personal and small business short-term insurance. Additionally, it offers long-term insurance policies for individuals, providing coverage for death, disability, critical illness, funeral costs, and retrenchment. Lastly, the Hastings segment specializes in digital general insurance, predominantly serving the private motor vehicle market, and also extends to other personal insurance products like home, van, and bike coverage.
